newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: BAHRAIN TO OPEN $3.3 MLN WATER BOTTLING PLANT.
newsitem.headline: BAHRAIN TO OPEN $3.3 MLN WATER BOTTLING PLANT.

text.p: Bahrain will inaugurate a 1.25 million dinar ($3.3 million) water bottling plant next week, the company owning the plant said on Monday.
Bahrain Water Bottling & Beverages Co said Commerce Minister Ali Saleh Abdullah al-Saleh would open the plant next Monday.
The plant has a capacity to produce 100,000 litres of mineral water per day, the statement said.
It said it was on the verge of exporting its products to Qatar, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and other Gulf Arab states. It gave no further details. ($1=0.377 dinars)
